verify.note: Default and Enhanced: every recording, at every hook the hook against the original from the same state, every register with R and all 48K RAM but the changed bytes and the stack below SP, every Layer 2 picture against an independent model; ABI cases on p1a's states; broken builds on p1a's first 3,000 frames (Enhanced: 'colours: clipped rows not skipped' is never reached in the recordings and is listed, not counted).
